name: YN Gokarter
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve locs, red cap/goggles, red/black/white checked flame racing outfit, gloves, jewelry, sneakers and red flame-painted kart. Review exactly one driver/four-wheel kart, hand steering, three checkpoint sequence, warm bounded tire streaks and no road/background field.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

YN Gokarter — Lap Record.
IDENTITY: exact young adult brown-skinned racer with tied dark locs, small cheek bandage, red cap with goggles, black/red/white racing jacket with checker panels and flame designs, white shirt, baggy matching trousers, red/black gloves, gold jewelry and white/red/black sneakers. Preserve the low red flame-painted FOUR-WHEEL go-kart, exposed metal frame, black seat, slick tires and compact rear engine. Keep the face clear; the spare helmet from the reference is clipped securely behind the seat.
0–0.7s: complete driver drops into the kart, grabs the steering wheel and stomps the throttle. Its rear tires distort from torque for one strong anticipation beat, and two short bounded ivory/red exhaust streaks snap backward. Ahead are THREE isolated round metal checkpoint discs with one orange cone on each, suspended at different depths on pure cyan. No road connecting them.
0.7–2.5s: camera chases the kart through a breathtaking three-checkpoint figure-eight. It skims the first small disc in a tight sideways drift, launches to the second and snaps the opposite way, then vaults toward the third. Show one continuous kart, no duplicates or split-screen. Each tire contact gives a sharp red/ivory crescent that ends freely on cyan. On the THIRD checkpoint he twists into a violent 360-degree donut, the compact disc spinning underneath like a giant turntable while his kart stays controlled. The cone flies straight upward from the final tire impact.
2.5–3.5s: the final donut releases one enormous bounded ivory/red acceleration burst; the kart shoots toward camera and stops in a hard sideways hero skid, all four wheels in frame. Exact title LAP RECORD slams above the kart nose and below his face with a dominant engine-and-tire BOOM. No lap digits, scoreboard, track scenery or extra wording.
3.5–5s: pull enough to show full kart and driver. He raises a casual thumb while the cone finally drops and lands neatly on the rear engine cover. He glances at it, gives a tiny shrug, then flicks the throttle once for a final mischievous engine blip. SFX: throttle click, torque growl, three rapid tire squeals, rising jump rushes, huge final drift CRACK, title slam, cone tap and motor blip. No music, speech, crowd or opaque tire-smoke panels.
